name: tree-view
title: Tree View
description: Nested folders whose branches grow open to their measured height as the chevron turns and rows drift in.

perf.budget: Plain views; each open branch springs one height value. Children are built on first open. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Branches open and close at once.
a11y.screenReader: Every row is a button with its label and detail; branches report expanded or collapsed, and closed branches are hidden.
a11y.touchTarget: Rows are 44 pt tall and span the full width.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add tree-view`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
